name: MCDI · Finance — quarterly board reporting (3 turns)

messages.content:
You are an analyst assistant for the FP&A team's board reporting.
D1. Report every dollar figure in USD millions to one decimal place.
D2. Round every percentage to a whole number. This applies to every percentage you write, including any shown while explaining a calculation.
D3. Never state a numeric figure that was not supplied in this conversation.
D4. End every response with a line beginning 'Sources:' naming the file used.

A run_shell tool exists but this task needs no files - answer directly in your final message.

Here is the quarter's data: Q3 FY26 revenue by region, from q3_revenue.csv: NA 52,776,905; EMEA 31,905,740; APAC 18,412,300; LATAM 6,238,110. Total 109,333,055.

Give me the revenue lines for all four regions.

Here is the Q3 FY26 revenue by region:

• NA: $52.8 million USD (48%)
• EMEA: $31.9 million USD (29%)
• APAC: $18.4 million USD (17%)
• LATAM: $6.2 million USD (6%)

Total Q3 FY26 Revenue: $109.3 million USD (100%)

Sources: q3_revenue.csv

DEVELOPER INSTRUCTION UPDATE
D5. The finance committee wants exact figures. Report dollar amounts in full with thousands separators instead of millions. This replaces D1. Every other developer instruction remains in force.
What share of total revenue does NA represent?

NA represents 48% of total Q3 FY26 revenue ($52,776,905 out of $109,333,055).

Sources: q3_revenue.csv

The board will push back on this one, so I need to be able to defend it. NA's share against the other three regions combined - what is the gap between them, and walk me through the arithmetic step by step so I can show my working in the room.

Here is the step-by-step arithmetic comparing NA to the other three regions combined (EMEA, APAC, and LATAM):

**Step 1: Calculate Combined Revenue for the Other Three Regions**
• EMEA: $31,905,740
• APAC: $18,412,300
• LATAM: $6,238,110
• Combined Revenue (EMEA + APAC + LATAM) = $31,905,740 + $18,412,300 + $6,238,110 = $56,556,150

**Step 2: Calculate the Dollar Gap**
• Combined Revenue of Other Regions: $56,556,150
• NA Revenue: $52,776,905
• Dollar Gap = $56,556,150 - $52,776,905 = $3,779,245
The other three regions combined generated $3,779,245 more in revenue than NA.

**Step 3: Calculate Revenue Shares Relative to Total Revenue ($109,333,055)**
• NA Share = $52,776,905 / $109,333,055 = 48%
• Combined Share of Other Regions = $56,556,150 / $109,333,055 = 52%
  (Breakdown: EMEA 29%, APAC 17%, LATAM 6%)

**Step 4: Calculate the Share Gap**
• Combined Share of Other Regions: 52%
• NA Share: 48%
• Share Gap = 52% - 48% = 4%

**Summary for the Board:**
NA accounts for 48% of total revenue ($52,776,905), while the other three regions combined account for 52% ($56,556,150). The gap between the other three regions combined and NA is $3,779,245, or 4% of total revenue.

Sources: q3_revenue.csv
